ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region. Black pigmentation borders the trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes. A high-contrast dark vertical streak extends from the median notch toward the peduncle. Distinct black mottling and spots are mapped on the outer third of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 50 degrees and a deep vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe displays fine-to-medium frequency serrations (2-4px amplitude). Right lobe displays high-amplitude, irregular macrotrauma serrations (peaks up to 25px) characterized by deep, jagged valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a slightly convex leading edge trajectory. Right lobe shows a more rounded, highly convex sweep leading to an blunt, irregular tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the distal portion of the left lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and traumatic serration along the trailing edge of the right lobe; significant dark pigmentation clusters on the white field of the right lobe near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between the relatively intact left lobe trailing edge and the severely jagged/shredded right lobe trailing edge.
